meta.tier: RESEARCH / SHADOW — measurements, not signals. Nothing here touches admission, ranking, sizing or any surface.
meta.ruler: gate-matched matched-set delta = event value - median of the same-session gate-matched controls; month-block bootstrap primary, ticker-cluster bootstrap as the recurrence check; per-name-first medians and a midpoint half-split beside the pooled read
meta.frame_identity_note: raw, excess_spy and excess_xs report the SAME delta_median_pp by construction, and that is not a copy-paste defect: the same-session control median already removes every additive session constant, and the SPY return and the cross-sectional median ARE session constants. The three frames therefore differ only in their unmatched pooled medians and loser rates. dd and mfe are per-name path statistics, not session constants, so their deltas are genuinely different reads.

S_ROCX_TOP.construction: roc12 = close/close.shift(12)-1; own-history percentile (rolling 252d, min_periods 126) >= 0.95 (severe 0.98) AND close > SMA50 AND SMA50 rising over 10 sessions. Controls: same uptrend legs, percentile in [0.50, 0.80).

redundancy_vs_ext_z.decision_statistic: mean_cross_sectional_pearson (fence applied to the LARGEST |rho| of the four reads — fail-closed)

absolute_strata_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.note: absolute ROC bands are DESCRIPTIVE. The VIX absolute-threshold kill (DO_NOT_REBUILD row 109) fences non-stationary absolute anchors out of primary constructions; the per-name percentile above is primary.

S_ROCX_TOP.primary_read: dd_within_h delta at H=21 (deeper drawdown after the extreme?)
S_ROCX_TOP.hypothesis_sign: NEGATIVE delta on dd and on excess would support blow-off termination

S_BURST_RHYTHM.construction: burst-movers = own trailing p97 of roc5 >= +15%, evaluated AT the bar. B1 = roc5 >= own p97 AND the trailing 63d low sits in the prior 10 sessions. Rest = cumulative return from the B1 bar inside [-50%, +25%] of the B1 5d gain for 2-5 sessions; the fire is the first session AFTER the completed rest. Control (a) = the rest gave back >61.8% of the burst; control (b) = no rest, roc5 makes a new high in each of sessions 1..5.
thin_notes: control arm (b) strict (roc5 makes a new high in each of sessions 1..5): n=3 < MIN_CELL=30 — no delta/CI is reported for it. Why: of 14348 B1 bars, five consecutive strictly-rising roc5 readings is a rare shape — the close-based variant of the same cohort is reported beside it for exactly this reason. Arm (a) 'broken rest' is the PRIMARY control and carries the verdict

second_burst.definition: roc5 >= own trailing p95 at any bar in [e+1, e+15]

control_no_rest.note: arm too thin to compare (fire n=4283, control_no_rest n=3, MIN_CELL=30) — printed, not skipped

S_BURST_RHYTHM.primary_read: P(second burst within 15 sessions) vs control arm (a) 'broken rest'
S_BURST_RHYTHM.hypothesis_sign: POSITIVE difference would support the burst-rest-burst grammar

S_ROC12_TERM.construction: burst-movers within 5% of their own 63d high. Fire: roc12 >= own trailing p99 (252d). Control: same legs, roc12 own-history percentile in [0.80, 0.90).

top_proximity.definition: fraction of events whose max close over [t, t+62] already occurred within [t, t+5] — i.e. the extreme marked the local top

S_ROC12_TERM.hypothesis_sign: POSITIVE difference would support ROC(12) extremes marking local tops

S_ROCW_GRAIN.construction: step 1: roc21 <= own-history p05 (rolling 504d, min 252). step 2: the first session within the next 21 bars closing above the max close of the prior 5 sessions — THAT bar is the event. Controls: identical stabilization geometry after a MILDER decline (roc21 own-history percentile in [0.10, 0.30)).
S_ROCW_GRAIN.grain_note: SECTOR/ASSET grain deliberately — name-level standalone bottom timers are a killed family (PSS-F1/F3/F4, DO_NOT_REBUILD rows 70/72/73); no name-grain washout construction exists in this file.

universe.alignment: NYSE session index from the equity panel; non-equity series forward-filled at most 1 session to bridge calendar gaps (20 bars bridged)
universe.pit_caveat: basket membership is TODAY's membership.json (removed members excluded for the whole history) — composition look-ahead is stated, not corrected
universe.dd_basis: close (grain series carry no intraday high/low)

S_ROCW_GRAIN.outcome_note: excess-vs-SPY on a futures series is a CROSS-ASSET read, not a like-for-like benchmark — the raw frame is reported beside it for exactly that reason. dd is close-based at this grain.

held_low_21.definition: the min close over [t+1, t+21] stays above the step-1 washout low (min close from the trough bar through the event bar)

S_ROCW_GRAIN.primary_read: excess_spy delta at H=21 under the declared matching
S_ROCW_GRAIN.hypothesis_sign: POSITIVE delta would support a tradable washout-stabilization zone

S_BURST_RHYTHM.driver: delta -17.46 CI [-22.29, -11.38] n=4283; P(2nd burst) fire 40.91% vs broken-rest 58.37%
S_BURST_RHYTHM.read: P(second burst <=15 sessions) fire minus control arm (a)
